observations.contract: Right-hinged gate doorway and passage geometry
observations.trace: PropertySide::Right has sign +1. CityGate::door sets hinge to C + tangent * width / 2 while retaining closed centre C and tangent. GateDatum passes these X/Z positions and tangent through. spawn_door computes doorway = hinge + tangent * width / 2 for both hinge sides. Thus, for right hinge, doorway = C + tangent * width in exact real arithmetic; the left side produces C. Both SceneDoor and DoorController receive this same displaced doorway. City boundary construction uses hinge = passage_side.opposite() and width 1.6m. For axis-aligned orientation, an actor one metre inside at C has signed depth -1 and lateral distance 1.6m, while the allowed lateral distance is 0.8 + 0.6 = 1.4m. The source therefore rejects the grab under those preconditions. A previously exempt actor at that same position fails within_passage and would be revoked on the selected fixed-update branch.
observations.remaining: This is symbolic source reasoning, not an executed function, generated scene, actor, collision, motor result or product incident. Normal authored f32 roundoff is immaterial to the 0.2m margin for the axis-aligned example; actual scene admission and actor accessibility are not proven. Source tests express both passage orientations but were not run. Preserve opposite-side inward swing, established door placement, collision and exemption policy in any future repair.

observations.trace: At closed identity rotation and position C, report_unseated_doors computes the leaf hinge as C - tangent * half-width unconditionally. Its controller expression reconstructs the actual right hinge C + tangent * half-width. For width 1.6m the resulting symbolic separation is 1.6m, above the 0.03m warning threshold, although that comparison alone does not establish physical joint failure.
observations.remaining: Position and Rotation components at those values, diagnostic execution and native physics behavior are unobserved. This is a related symptom of the handedness mismatch, not a separate demonstrated physics defect.

observations.contract: Fallible scene assembly and error handler
observations.trace: Building doors collect all converted poses before their spawn loop; each spawn independently calculates and admits its doorway position before queuing its own leaf. After doors, window compilation and per-window datum conversion occur; a later window error can follow earlier queued door or window commands. The Bevy0.19.1 observer runner invokes the error handler before queue_deferred. Generic BevyError conversion sets Panic severity; the default fallback matches severity to panic. If a nonpanicking handler is in force, the runner proceeds to queue_deferred. No matching fallback-handler override was found by Git text search in crates, which does not establish every plugin or external application configuration.
observations.remaining: No actual malformed plan, overflow, custom handler, command, scene or error was observed. A later queued-prefix effect cannot be asserted for the ordinary default panic path. Gate and building source admission and cleanup policy remain open.

observations.trace: Current server source constructs SceneDoor and DoorController geometry from one local datum; selected passage iteration only visits extant controllers, while exemptions are sets of Bevy Entity values on characters. No desynchronizing geometry mutation was found in selected server text search; no lifecycle cleanup proof follows from that search.
observations.remaining: Entity generation, external mutation, delete/reload and retained filters are not fully traced. A transient leak or wrong collision has not been established.

conditional_findings.kind: source-derived gate handedness and interaction geometry
conditional_findings.qualification: For a right-hinged CityGate, server spawn computes the doorway centre one full leaf width beyond the closed centre. In the axis-aligned symbolic 1.6m gate example, an actor one metre inside at the closed centre fails the 1.4m lateral grab threshold; no gameplay, physics, scene generation or test ran.
